propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reduced average dock-to-stock time from 9.2 to 7.4 hours between January and June 2024, measured from receipt timestamps against a January baseline.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the figures and period, and the work sample carries the baseline and June extracts, the method note and the sign-off.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certificate that is listed as valid on the issuing body's public register.
propositions.rationale: The HR verification note records a check of the certificate against the issuing body's register.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate planned weekly labour rosters and dock-door schedules for two distribution centres.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the planning work directly.

expectedGap: The certification is verified, but how often the receiving standard work was revised is not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the dock-to-stock result with its baseline, period and timestamp definition, and keep the verified certificate; do not extend the result beyond the two sites and the January to June window.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how and when the receiving standard work documents were revised after the improvement reviews.
